mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS DIDCNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE A.DID_STTUS = 'Y') AS ONCNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE A.DID_STTUS != 'Y') AS OFFCNT FROM TB_DIDINFO A WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE IN ('DIDRMODELTYPE01', 'DIDRMODELTYPE02')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS DIDCNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE A.DID_STTUS = 'Y') AS ONCNT, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE A.DID_STTUS != 'Y') AS OFFCNT FROM TB_DIDINFO A WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE = 'DIDRMODELTYPE03'

SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TB.didEndcontime DESC NULLS LAST) AS RNUM, -- 서브쿼리 밖이라 A 별칭 사용 불가 TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.DID_NM AS didNm, B.CENTER_NM AS centerNm, CASE A.DID_STTUS WHEN 'N' THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS didStatus, TO_CHAR(A.DID_ENDCONTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS didEndcontime, A.DID_ID FROM TB_DIDINFO A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE IN ('DIDRMODELTYPE01', 'DIDRMODELTYPE02') AND A.DID_STTUS != 'Y' ) TB ) X WHERE X.RNUM BETWEEN #{firstIndex} + 1 AND #{firstIndex} + #{recordCountPerPage}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_DIDINFO A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE IN ('DIDRMODELTYPE01', 'DIDRMODELTYPE02') AND A.DID_STTUS != 'Y'

SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TB.didEndcontime DESC NULLS LAST) AS RNUM, -- 서브쿼리 밖이라 A 별칭 사용 불가 TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.DID_NM AS didNm, B.CENTER_NM AS centerNm, CASE A.DID_STTUS WHEN 'N' THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS didStatus, TO_CHAR(A.DID_ENDCONTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS didEndcontime, A.DID_ID FROM TB_DIDINFO A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE = 'DIDRMODELTYPE03' AND A.DID_STTUS != 'Y' ) TB ) X WHERE X.RNUM BETWEEN #{firstIndex} + 1 AND #{firstIndex} + #{recordCountPerPage}
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_DIDINFO A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE = 'DIDRMODELTYPE03' AND A.DID_STTUS != 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DIDINFO SET DID_STTUS = 'Y' WHERE (DID_ENDCONTIME + INTERVAL '2 minute') >= NOW()
UPDATE TB_DIDINFO SET DID_STTUS = 'N' WHERE (DID_ENDCONTIME + INTERVAL '2 minute') < NOW()
